title: The female family line

seo.title: The female family line in the destiny matrix — meaning of the position
seo.description: Point G in the destiny matrix: the spiritual principle the female family branch passes on, how its resource shows and how it differs from the relationship line.
queries: mother line in the destiny matrix
maternal line by date of birth
arcanum of the female family line

meaning: Point G describes the spiritual principle of the female branch of the family: what this family counted as care, as dignity, as staying true to yourself and as a way of keeping life going around them. It is not a portrait of your mother and not a sentence to repeat her fate — rather an inherited language of values that a person can recognise even in their own disagreement with the family.

Some receive quiet steadiness through this branch, others the courage to start again, and others meet the principle in a twisted form first: care becomes control, patience becomes self-erasure, and loyalty becomes fear of change. The sense of the reading is not the label but giving the resource back its sound form.

It helps to set G beside I: the first point is spiritual, the second shows the material expression of the female line. Reading them together separates the family value from the everyday scenario and lets you see what you really want to keep and what you can stop reproducing.

The relationship line does not start here; it starts at M and runs through R1 to R. The experience of the mother’s branch can of course affect closeness, but point G does not stand in for the separate love channel — these are two different questions of the chart.
